CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CustomerAccountParticipation_TRY
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
AS(
SELECT
convert(varchar,BTL.ID) AS CustomerAccountId
,VALUE AS CustomerId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,BTL.INSERT_DTTM)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,NULL AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,BTL.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
,BTLD.RECORD_STATUS
,BTL.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.TRY_LegalEntity_DELTA BTLD
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY ID) RN, * FROM BUSC.TRY_LegalEntity BTL --ON BTLD.ID = BTL.ID AND BTLD.Status = BTL.Status AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1
CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(BTL.External_Ref, '|')
where BTL.STATUS != 'Disabled' 
AND (BTL.ROLES LIKE '%Client%' OR BTL.ROLES LIKE '%CounterParty%')
AND (BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'GROUP-%' OR BTL.FULL_NAME not like 'SETTLEMENT BANK%') AND BTL.ISLATEST = 1 AND VALUE <> ''  )A

--WHERE A.RN = 1 
) BTL ON BTLD.ID = BTL.ID AND BTLD.Status = BTL.Status
WHERE BTL.ID IS NOT NULL

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL AND SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'TRY'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,CASE
	WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORD TO BNKM
--
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL

--INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.PeriodEndDate)) AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,SRC.CustomerAccountParticipationNote AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'TRY' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId




--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation
(
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM
)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CustomerId AS CustomerId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodEndDate)) AS PeriodEndDate
,CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage AS CustomerAccountParticipationPercentage
,CustomerAccountParticipationNote AS CustomerAccountParticipationNote
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,'TRY' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation
WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountParticipation_DELTA;

END
